author: kdab38
body:
Hi, my username is kdab38 and I have been banned by SirCyanide for Team Trolling. I am not sure how or when I team trolled all of a sudden I was kicked. I have been  having problems with my mouse recently and sometimes it glitches when I lift it, I apologize for whatever it is that I have done. I was wondering if this could be looked into because I have never done anything that I know of that has been bad to this server, it happens to be one of my favorite servers, so I hope this can be reversed and l can play on this server again soon.
Thanks! Kdab38
